lesson_name: Future in the Past (Was going to / Would)

vocabulary.meaning: A past plan or intention that often did not happen

meaning_translation.Hindi: एक पिछली योजना या इरादा जो अक्सर नहीं हुआ
meaning_translation.Japanese: 過去に計画したが実現しなかった意図

examples.sentence: I was going to call you, but I forgot.

translation.Hindi: मैं तुम्हें कॉल करने वाला था, लेकिन मैं भूल गया।
translation.Japanese: 電話するつもりだったが、忘れてしまった。

vocabulary.meaning: Used to express future ideas from a past perspective

meaning_translation.Hindi: अतीत के दृष्टिकोण से भविष्य की बात करने के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है
meaning_translation.Japanese: 過去の視点から未来のことを表す

examples.sentence: He said he would help me with my homework.

translation.Hindi: उसने कहा कि वह मेरा होमवर्क करने में मदद करेगा।
translation.Japanese: 彼は宿題を手伝うと言った。

vocabulary.meaning: Something expected or intended but not always done

meaning_translation.Hindi: कुछ ऐसा जो अपेक्षित था या इरादा था लेकिन हमेशा नहीं हुआ
meaning_translation.Japanese: 予定されていたが必ずしも行われなかったこと

examples.sentence: I was supposed to finish the report yesterday.

translation.Hindi: मुझे कल रिपोर्ट पूरी करनी थी।
translation.Japanese: 昨日報告書を終えるはずだった。

word_translation.Japanese: まさに〜しようとしていた

vocabulary.meaning: Indicates something that was just on the point of happening

meaning_translation.Hindi: कुछ ऐसा जो बस होने वाला था
meaning_translation.Japanese: まさに起こりそうだったこと

examples.sentence: I was about to leave when the phone rang.

translation.Hindi: जैसे ही मैं निकलने वाला था तभी फोन बजा।
translation.Japanese: 出かけようとしたときに電話が鳴った。

vocabulary.meaning: Expected or looked forward to as happening in the future (from a past view)

meaning_translation.Hindi: अतीत से भविष्य में होने की उम्मीद या प्रत्याशा
meaning_translation.Japanese: 過去の視点から未来に起こると期待されたこと

examples.sentence: They anticipated that the trip would be exciting.

translation.Hindi: उन्होंने अनुमान लगाया कि यात्रा रोमांचक होगी।
translation.Japanese: 旅行は楽しいだろうと予想していた。

vocabulary.meaning: Believed something would happen in the future

meaning_translation.Hindi: विश्वास था कि कुछ भविष्य में होगा
meaning_translation.Japanese: 未来に起こると信じられていたこと

examples.sentence: She expected that he would arrive on time.

translation.Hindi: उसने उम्मीद की कि वह समय पर पहुंचेगा।
translation.Japanese: 彼は時間通りに来るだろうと彼女は思っていた。

vocabulary.meaning: Said what would happen in the future based on knowledge or belief

meaning_translation.Hindi: ज्ञान या विश्वास के आधार पर बताया कि भविष्य में क्या होगा
meaning_translation.Japanese: 知識や信念に基づいて未来に起こることを述べた

examples.sentence: The scientist predicted that the experiment would fail.

translation.Hindi: वैज्ञानिक ने भविष्यवाणी की कि प्रयोग असफल होगा।
translation.Japanese: 科学者は実験が失敗すると予測した。

vocabulary.meaning: Said that someone would certainly do something

meaning_translation.Hindi: कहा कि कोई निश्चित रूप से कुछ करेगा
meaning_translation.Japanese: 誰かが必ず何かをすると言った

examples.sentence: He promised that he would call me back.

translation.Hindi: उसने वादा किया कि वह मुझे वापस कॉल करेगा।
translation.Japanese: 彼は折り返し電話すると約束した。

vocabulary.meaning: Planned or meant to do something

meaning_translation.Hindi: कुछ करने की योजना बनाई या इरादा किया
meaning_translation.Japanese: 何かをする計画を持っていた

examples.sentence: I intended to visit her, but I was too busy.

translation.Hindi: मेरा उसे मिलने का इरादा था, लेकिन मैं बहुत व्यस्त था।
translation.Japanese: 彼女を訪ねるつもりだったが、とても忙しかった。

vocabulary.meaning: Believed something would happen without proof

meaning_translation.Hindi: बिना प्रमाण के विश्वास किया कि कुछ होगा
meaning_translation.Japanese: 証拠なしに何かが起こると信じた

examples.sentence: We assumed the train would arrive on time.

translation.Hindi: हमने मान लिया कि ट्रेन समय पर आएगी।
translation.Japanese: 列車は時間通りに到着するだろうと想定した。

grammar_tips.title: Was going to + Verb
grammar_tips.explanation: Use 'was/were going to + verb' for past plans or intentions that often did not happen. Example: I was going to study, but I fell asleep.

explanation_translation.Hindi: 'was/were going to + verb' का प्रयोग अतीत की योजनाओं या इरादों के लिए करें जो अक्सर नहीं हुए। उदाहरण: I was going to study, but I fell asleep.
explanation_translation.Japanese: 過去の計画や意図に「was/were going to + 動詞」を使います。例：I was going to study, but I fell asleep.

grammar_tips.title: Would for Future in the Past
grammar_tips.explanation: Use 'would' to describe future events from a past viewpoint. Example: She knew he would arrive late.

explanation_translation.Hindi: अतीत के दृष्टिकोण से भविष्य की घटनाओं का वर्णन करने के लिए 'would' का उपयोग करें। उदाहरण: She knew he would arrive late.
explanation_translation.Japanese: 過去の視点から未来の出来事を表すときに「would」を使います。例：She knew he would arrive late.

grammar_tips.title: Was supposed to
grammar_tips.explanation: Use 'was/were supposed to' for expectations or duties in the past. Example: I was supposed to meet him at 5.

explanation_translation.Hindi: 'was/were supposed to' का उपयोग अतीत की अपेक्षाओं या कर्तव्यों के लिए करें। उदाहरण: I was supposed to meet him at 5.
explanation_translation.Japanese: 過去の期待や義務には「was/were supposed to」を使います。例：I was supposed to meet him at 5.

grammar_tips.title: Reported Speech with Would
grammar_tips.explanation: In reported speech, 'will' changes to 'would' when reporting from the past. Example: He said he would call me.

explanation_translation.Hindi: Reported speech में, 'will' अतीत में रिपोर्ट करने पर 'would' में बदल जाता है। उदाहरण: He said he would call me.
explanation_translation.Japanese: 過去の視点から報告するとき、'will' は 'would' に変わります。例：He said he would call me.

grammar_tips.title: Was about to
grammar_tips.explanation: Use 'was/were about to' for something that was on the point of happening. Example: I was about to leave when you arrived.

explanation_translation.Hindi: 'was/were about to' का प्रयोग किसी ऐसी चीज़ के लिए करें जो बस होने वाली थी। उदाहरण: I was about to leave when you arrived.
explanation_translation.Japanese: まさに起こりそうだったことには「was/were about to」を使います。例：I was about to leave when you arrived.
